g.text: Hospital node database schema (ER, crow's-foot notation). * = NOT NULL
Columns marked «no FK» hold ids from the
supplier hub. There is no database link
between node and hub; the client carries them.
The node has no jobs table (D53): normalization
runs in one batch at ingestion (D56) and
projection rebuilds run inside the writing
transaction. llm_calls logs that one call.
A fact is current while superseded_by_id and
retracted_at are both NULL; retracted_at is for
current product). A refused issuance writes an
egress row with an alert and no content.
No assessment table: the client lists
assessments from the hub and joins them by
